source_caption_text:
From Worcester, MA to New Hampshire

@oficialraalopr brought both sides of his artistry to New Hampshire for the Project X Artist Showcase, showing exactly why his sound continues to reach beyond his hometown. Representing Worcester, MA, Raalo delivered a bilingual performance in both English and Spanish, blending different influences, perspectives, and sounds into one experience.

The showcase was a reminder that music doesn’t have to live in just one lane or one world. Raalo showed up representing where he comes from while connecting with a new crowd and letting the music speak for itself. From Worcester to New Hampshire, the message is simple: the sound is bigger than the city. 🌎🔥🇵🇷
